title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Alex Warren's "Fever Dream" — a warm, aching pop ballad about being swept off your feet so completely it feels half-dreamt. Off his 2026 project WILDCHILD, it opens on a fragile confession ("how did you know I was hoping for a sign") and swells into a soaring, whole-hearted chorus: "something about you hit me like a freight train to the chest — the day we met." In a Djembe set it lands as a tender, breathy centerpiece that builds earnestly and lets the room lean in.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Alex Warren's tender pop ballad "Fever Dream" joins the request catalog this week.
